cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Hope Keeps Moving
cards.instruction: Turn every disappointment into a new reason the desired outcome is delayed, redirected, or becoming more meaningful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put return labels on the books like you. Off to our next shop. This one failed because our readers are somewhere else.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Those go back to the wholesaler. We haven't got money to move shops.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, send those ahead. We'll start with the books we own: one shelf, properly chosen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can get us a market stall beside the bus stop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: People waiting with nothing to read. Pack the short stories with me; we've been making customers come too far.
